name: com.midtrans.sdk.uikit.views.banktransfer.status.VaOtherBankPaymentStatusActivity
description: After a user starts virtual-account transfers at another bank in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen shows the payment result and the virtual-account number and instructions for completing the transfer.
disableEffect: Disabling it can hide the virtual-account transfers at another bank payment result or the instructions needed to complete it.
